name: Hootsuite
desc: Social media management — schedule posts and manage multiple networks from one dashboard.

actions.name: create_message
actions.description: Schedules or immediately publishes a post to one or more social media profiles.

actions.name: get_message
actions.description: Retrieves the details of a specific scheduled or published post by its ID.

actions.name: delete_message
actions.description: Permanently deletes a post. Only posts in a deletable state (e.g. SCHEDULED) can be removed.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_scheduled_post
triggers.description: Triggers when a new post is scheduled in Hootsuite.

triggers.name: new_published_post
triggers.description: Triggers when a post is published (sent) in Hootsuite.
